join hortbot 2 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote add "This is a test."
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote add "This is a test?"
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote add "This is a TeSt."
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote add "Give 100%"
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote add "Give _ 110%"
send_any


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote getindex "This is a TeSt."
send hortbot #foobar [HB] That's quote #3.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote getindex uhhhh
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote not found; make sure your quote is exact.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote getindex
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !quote getindex <quote>


handle hortbot foobar/1 random/3 :!quote getindex "This is a TeSt."
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/3 access=subscriber :!quote getindex "Give 100%"
send hortbot #foobar [HB] That's quote #4.
